title: The Necessary Mask
genre: constructive position book in ethics and institutional design
narrativeSpine: Incomplete virtue can support development or extract moral rent; taxonomy and a proposed limit passport make the difference inspectable.
firstSceneDraft: The Necessary Mask examines why inconsistency is not always the same moral failure.
This position book starts with the distance between declared ideals and actual conduct.
A standard can guide development before someone fully embodies it.
The same gap can also become a device for extracting credit and power.
visualActionProposal: A bright rehearsal/workshop scaffold helps a learner cross a real gap, then a gatekeeper attempts to add a toll; later a discrepancy ledger beside actual work.
